name: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc.
summary: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of processed meat and processed/precooked food products in Japan. The company operates in two segments: Processed Food Division and Meat Division. It offers ham, sausages, and prepared foods under ITOHAM and YONEKYU brands. In addition, the company is involved in production, processing, and sale of meat and ready-to-cook products. Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc. was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
